def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    player_patches = image_patch.find("player")
    hat_patches = image_patch.find("hat")
    
    if not player_patches or not hat_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    player_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in player_patches]
    hat_centers = [(h.left + h.right) / 2, (h.lower + h.upper) / 2 for h in hat_patches]
    
    closest_player = min(player_patches, key=lambda p: min(distance(p, ImagePatch(image, *hat)) for hat in hat_patches))
    
    return closest_player
